name: Comms dish on a turntable
brief: MK-005 Comms dish on a turntable. Round 2, matched to the pick: a domed, framed turntable housing with warm orange windows, a yoke and a 3.2 m panelled dish with a feed on three struts and a red blinker. It turns to follow Earth; when it is talking to home the windows pulse and the turntable hums.

rounds.t: First build from the pack style and the Faceted Hero rules, no Midjourney pick yet.
Rebuilt against the Midjourney pick: chunky off-white modules held by dark bumper frames (bkit.module), warm orange windows (bkit.window), darker ground. Round 1 kept in round1/.
